Title: AeroGarden vs Click & Grow for a small apartment — which would you buy first?

Body: I put together an apartment-focused comparison of AeroGarden Harvest-class vs Click & Grow Smart Garden 3 (noise, footprint, refill cost — not brand ads).

Quick take:
- More herbs / separate kitchen → AeroGarden Harvest-class
- Studio / sleep in the same room → Click & Grow (no pump)

Full write-up: https://sillgarden.com/guides/aerogarden-vs-click-and-grow/
Disclosure: https://sillgarden.com/disclosure/

Curious what people here actually kept plugged in after month two.
